snippet.title: Sonic Riders TE - 2.4.6 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Who's ready for this year's SAGE? Well, here we are with a little treat for the community!

We come to you with the release of SRTE version 2.4.6, which features an additional character who uses skates for their default gear for the first time, along with a brand new gear! You can find the patch notes in this announcement for a quick overview, but see this as something to sink your teeth into while we work on the next big patch. The team worked hard on this update, so we hope you enjoy and would appreciate if you hyped up our sage post! 

Download: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-riders-tournament-edition-2-4-6.2703/
